notes.title: ver1.10 Updated! (Implementation of the English version, UI improvements)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929069/7c2b61342a47c54c02fd724033b990c299c53980.png[/img]
Implementation of the English version:
At the first launch, you can choose the language, and it's also possible to change it anytime in the options (Config).
I mostly rely on machine translation, so there might be some odd translations. I'd appreciate it if native speakers could discreetly point them out to me.

UI improvements:
Enable the use of the keyboard for name input.
Pressing the X key allows for immediate actions like saving.
Some text and map event corrections. (I've relaxed some conditions regarding potential stuck-save points and added prompts to encourage players to save in advance.)
Removal of the always dash and command memory from the options, and addition of fullscreen settings.
Added a "Shutdown" option to the title.
Update of the bonus room.
Upgrade NW.js to the latest version (for profile error prevention).

During your first playthrough, the language selection screen will be displayed. For those who have already played, please switch languages from the "Language（言語）" option in the "Options（オプション）" menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929069/463e4fc78872ff57bd6d166aacdfe7b3501ec9fa.png[/img]
